order: Run the exercise pass for the review's roster and record every outcome in full. Audit the Conductor's session against the role's guardrails and rule a disposition for the violation found — the audit stands as a full written record and must never shrink into a summary. Live-exercise the P0 substrate end to end and produce its own written report from the run. Attempt the Architect role too, even if the environment blocks it. Preserve the blocked attempt as its own transcript rather than discarding it, and keep a second transcript on a repeated attempt rather than overwriting the first. Update the band record and status summary to the real per-seat outcomes, confining the update to what was actually exercised with no placeholder or aspirational line standing. Extend the test suite only as far as the exercise runs require, and the substrate's own production behavior is not touched.
claims: We audited the Conductor's transcript and ruled a disposition for the one violation found, recorded as a full written audit. The P0 substrate was live-exercised end to end and its outcome checked into a written report. The Architect exercise was attempted twice; the environment blocked it both times, and both transcripts were kept as the record rather than merged into one. The status summary and band record were updated to the true per-seat outcomes, and the test suite gained exercise-support changes only.
